Where to Stay on Koh Lipe?
10 Hotels We've Reviewed

heroSub: Ten Koh Lipe hotels across every budget — 5-star pool villas on Sunrise Beach down to value beachfront bungalows and a hostel. Covering the 3 main beaches: Sunrise, Pattaya, and Sunset. Starting from around ฿320–14,500/night.
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right beach on Koh Lipe matter?
introHtml: Koh Lipe is a small island in the Satun sea — you can walk across it in 15–20 minutes — but each beach has a distinct feel. Sunrise Beach is the long white-sand beach on the east side, clear water, calm, and good for sunrises; most resorts and pool villas are here · Pattaya Beach is the main beach on the south side where the speedboats land, lined with Walking Street, restaurants and bars — the liveliest spot · Sunset Beach is a small bay on the west side, the quietest, good for sunsets. Many travellers book without checking which beach, then end up dragging luggage across the island or missing the vibe they wanted. This guide brings together 10 Koh Lipe hotels we've reviewed across every tier — from luxury pool villas down to a hostel on Walking Street, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Lipe has no roads for cars and no public transport — getting around the island is on foot or by motorbike taxi (sidecar tuk-tuk); the island is small and walkable. To reach the island you take a speedboat from Pak Bara pier in Satun (about 1.5 hours), or from Tammalang pier / Langkawi, landing at Pattaya Beach. The main beaches in this guide: Sunrise Beach — long white-sand beach on the east side, quiet, clear water (Irene, Serendipity, Idyllic, Castaway, Cabana, Salisa, Anda) · Pattaya Beach — the main beach by Walking Street where boats land, lively (Ananya, Bundhaya, Bloom) · Sunset Beach — a small bay on the west side, the quietest (Z-Touch).

entries.name: Irene Resort Koh Lipe
entries.addr: Sunrise Beach, Ko Sarai, Mueang Satun · Koh Lipe
entries.storyHtml: Irene Resort is Koh Lipe's top-tier pool-villa luxury stay, awarded a MICHELIN Key 2025. Every villa is a pool villa with a private pool, in a white minimalist design that reviews praise often, set right on the white sand and clear water of Sunrise Beach. It ranges from the Tree Pool Villa on a wooded hillside to front-row beachfront villas where you step out onto the sand. It's a resort that sells privacy and design — ideal for a honeymoon or a special-occasion trip.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a direct beach spot pick the Sand or Sun Beachfront Pool Villa; the Tree Pool Villa on the hill is quieter and better value · Many Koh Lipe places close in low season (May–Oct), so check opening dates before booking.
pros: Every villa is a pool villa with a private pool
Awarded a MICHELIN Key 2025 · white minimalist design, often praised
On Sunrise Beach — white sand, clear water, calm
Choice of hillside and front-row beachfront villas
cons: Highest price in this guide — best for a special occasion
Still few reviews (130) as a newer resort

entries.name: Serendipity Beach Resort Koh Lipe
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Quiet end of Sunrise Beach · Koh Lipe
tags: 🏊 Pool villas with private plunge pool
🌊 Hillside timber villas with sea views
entries.storyHtml: Serendipity is a pool-villa resort at the quiet end of Sunrise Beach, scoring 8.9 from 222 reviews. What reviews mention most are the timber villas stepping up a hillside with Andaman sea views, and the higher tiers that come as pool villas with a private plunge pool. Starting at a Deluxe Seaview that's more accessible than the other luxury pool villas, while still giving you a quiet beach-end setting and sunrise views.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If a pool villa is out of budget, the Deluxe Seaview still gives a good sea view · It's at the far end of the beach, so it's a longer walk to Walking Street than a central resort — allow time.
pros: Hillside timber villas with Andaman sea views (per reviews)
Higher tiers are pool villas with a private plunge pool
At the quiet end of Sunrise Beach, private feel
Starting price more accessible than other luxury pool villas
cons: At the far end of the beach — longer walk to Walking Street
Hillside layout means some villas involve walking up and down

entries.name: Ananya Lipe Resort
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.2 · Booking 9.0 · 359 reviews · highest score in the guide
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pattaya Beach · by Walking Street · Koh Lipe

rooms.type: Royal Jacuzzi Pool Suite Sea View (183 sqm)

entries.storyHtml: Ananya is the highest-scoring resort in this guide at 9.0 from 359 reviews. What reviews highlight is the location on Pattaya Beach by Walking Street — easy walking to the boats, restaurants and bars — while the resort itself stays well-kept and modern. Rooms start at the modern Deluxe Regency Wing and climb through Pool Access rooms up to a jacuzzi sea-view suite. A great fit if you want to be in the middle of Koh Lipe's buzz but with quality rooms.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a walk-out-to-pool room choose the Deluxe Pool Access · Being by Walking Street it can be noisy at night — request an inner room if you want it quieter.
pros: Highest score in the guide — 9.0 from 359 reviews
On Pattaya Beach and Walking Street — walk to everything
Modern, well-kept rooms (per reviews)
Pool Access rooms and a jacuzzi sea-view suite available
cons: By Walking Street — bar noise possible at night
Pattaya Beach is lively with boats landing, not as quiet as Sunrise

entries.name: Idyllic Concept Resort

rooms.type: Deluxe Cabana / Studio Garden View (37 sqm)
Grand Suite Seaview with Jacuzzi (85 sqm)

entries.storyHtml: Idyllic Concept Resort is a design-led resort on Sunrise Beach, a Travelers' Choice 2026 winner, scoring 8.9 from 280 reviews. What reviews highlight is the modern design that stands apart from the timber bungalows found across the island, with rooms that feel contemporary right on the white sand of Sunrise. It ranges from a Deluxe Cabana up to a Premium Suite Beachfront and a Grand Suite with a jacuzzi and sea view. A good fit if you love design and want quieter Sunrise rather than the Pattaya side.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a beachfront spot pick the Premium Suite Beachfront; the garden-view Deluxe Cabana is better value if budget matters · Check opening dates around low season before booking.
pros: Modern design, distinct from the island's timber bungalows
Travelers' Choice 2026 · on Sunrise Beach
Ranges from Cabana rooms up to a jacuzzi sea-view suite
Sunrise Beach is quieter than the Pattaya side — white sand, clear water
cons: The starting Garden View room has no direct sea view
A 4-star, so the starting price is higher than typical beachfront resorts

entries.name: Bloom Cafe & Hostel Koh Lipe
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.8 · Booking 8.9 · 540 reviews · on Walking Street
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Walking Street · near Pattaya Beach · Koh Lipe
tags: 🛏️ Dorm beds with curtain, power & locker
entries.storyHtml: Bloom is the cheapest stay in this guide from just ฿320, right on Walking Street, scoring 8.9 from 540 reviews — very high for a hostel. What reviews call out is the dorm beds with a privacy curtain, power socket and locker, the in-house cafe, and a Walking Street location that puts restaurants, bars and Pattaya Beach 1–2 minutes away. There's a Private Double for those who want more privacy on a budget. Ideal for solo and backpacking travellers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more privacy on a budget choose the Private Double — still far cheaper than resorts across the island · It's on Walking Street, so lively nights can be noisy.
pros: Cheapest in the guide at ฿320 — on Walking Street
Dorm beds with privacy curtain, power socket and locker
In-house cafe · 1–2 minutes to restaurants, bars and Pattaya Beach
Very high 8.9 score for a hostel · private rooms available
cons: On Walking Street — lively nights can be noisy, not for those wanting quiet
Dorms and private rooms use shared bathrooms, not for families with young kids

entries.name: Castaway Resort Koh Lipe
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.5 · Booking 8.7 · 1,057 reviews · most reviewed in the guide
entries.addr: Sunrise Beach, Ko Lipe · Koh Lipe
entries.storyHtml: Castaway is a boutique timber-bungalow resort on Sunrise Beach — the most reviewed hotel in this guide at over 1,057 reviews, scoring 8.7. What reviews highlight are the two-storey eco-style timber bungalows with hammocks and balconies, set right on the natural Sunrise Beach. It ranges from Garden View up to Beach Front where you step out onto the sand. It sells island atmosphere over polish — a good fit if you love a beachfront-bungalow feel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To wake up facing the sea pick the front-row Beach Front Breezy · Some bungalows are eco fan-and-net style, so check whether your booked room has air-con if you want it.
pros: Most reviewed in the guide — 1,057 reviews, 8.7 score
Two-storey timber bungalows on Sunrise Beach with hammocks and balconies
Natural eco atmosphere with character (per reviews)
Ranges from garden-view to front-row beachfront
cons: Some bungalows are eco fan-and-net style — not every room has air-con
Sells a timber-bungalow feel, not a full-facility luxury resort

entries.name: Cabana Lipe Beach Resort
entries.storyHtml: Cabana is a mid-priced boutique beachfront resort on Sunrise Beach that reviews praise for its service, scoring 8.9 from 256 reviews. What reviews mention most is breakfast served to your beachfront balcony, a leafy island-resort feel, and the Deluxe Ocean Facing rooms that look straight out over Sunrise Beach. It ranges from an accessible Superior up to direct sea-view rooms. A good fit for mid-budget travellers who want quiet Sunrise Beach with good service.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a direct sea view, the Deluxe Ocean Facing is better value than the partial-view room · Book ahead in high season as beachfront rooms fill fast.
pros: Breakfast served to your beachfront balcony (per reviews)
Well-rated service · 8.9 overall from 256 reviews
Deluxe Ocean Facing rooms look straight out over Sunrise Beach
Leafy island-resort atmosphere, accessible mid-range price

entries.storyHtml: Bundhaya is a good-value resort on Pattaya Beach with a solid 345 reviews, scoring 8.9. What reviews highlight is the location on Pattaya Beach — the main beach where boats land — with easy walking to Walking Street, restaurants and bars. It has a wide range of bungalows, from a Superior from ฿1,600 up to Family Bungalows. A good-value pick right in the centre of Koh Lipe's convenience.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a family, pick a Family or Villa Family Bungalow for more space · The cheapest Superior is small, so allow for the size.

From ฿1,600, good value for being on the beach · a solid 345 reviews

entries.name: Salisa Resort Koh Lipe
entries.storyHtml: Salisa is an accessible, good-value resort by Sunrise Beach, scoring 8.6 from 144 reviews. What reviews highlight is the spot by white-sand, clear-water Sunrise Beach at a starting price that's easy on the budget. It ranges from a small Garden View room up to roomier Deluxe and Sea View / Family rooms with a sea view. A good fit for travellers on a tighter budget who want quiet Sunrise Beach over the livelier Pattaya side.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Garden View room is small and budget; for more space and a bit of a view step up to a Deluxe Double or Sea View · It's a small resort, so book ahead in high season.
pros: By Sunrise Beach — white sand, clear water — at an accessible starting price
Several room tiers from Garden View up to Sea View / Family
Sunrise Beach is quieter than the Pattaya side (per reviews)
8.6 score from 144 reviews — good for tighter budgets
cons: The Garden View room is very small (~12 sqm), set inside the resort

entries.name: Z-Touch Lipe Island Resort
entries.storyHtml: Z-Touch is a resort on Sunset Beach — the quietest of the main beaches, scoring 8.0. What reviews highlight is the west-side location on a small, calm bay where you can watch the sunset, away from the lively Pattaya Beach and the busier Sunrise. Rooms range from a Sea Breeze up to a Two Bedroom Family room. A good fit for those who want to escape the crowds and find the quietest spot on the island. Reviews are still few (33), but it's the only Sunset Beach option in this guide.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Sunset Beach is quiet and a longer walk to Walking Street than the other beaches — allow time to cross the island · Travelling as a family, pick the Two Bedroom Family Room.

Sunset views, an escape-the-crowds feel

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare the 3 sites before booking. Koh Lipe room rates are relatively high and swing with the season: during high season (November–April, especially New Year and Songkran) prices rise and rooms sell out fast, so book 1–2 months ahead. During low season (May–October) the sea is rougher and many places close, so check opening dates before booking. Koh Lipe has no roads for cars — get around the island on foot or by motorbike taxi; reach the island by speedboat from Pak Bara pier in Satun, about 1.5 hours. Scores and standout factors come from reading real guest reviews, not from staying ourselves. Article by ThailandAddict.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Koh Lipe hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which beach should I stay on in Koh Lipe?
faq.a: It depends on your style · Sunrise Beach suits those who want a long white-sand beach with clear water, calm, and sunrises (Irene, Serendipity, Idyllic, Castaway, Cabana, Salisa) · Pattaya Beach is the main beach where boats land, by Walking Street with lots of restaurants and bars — the liveliest (Ananya, Bundhaya, Bloom) · Sunset Beach is a small bay on the west side, the quietest, good for sunsets (Z-Touch).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Lipe hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and beachfront bungalows start around ฿320–2,500/night · mid-range to 4-star beachfront resorts run about ฿2,800–6,500 · pool villas and luxury 5-star resorts start ฿4,200–14,500+ · Koh Lipe room rates are fairly high and swing with the season — during high season (New Year, Songkran and long weekends) they can be much higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Koh Lipe hotel?
faq.a: For weekdays in the regular season, booking 3–4 weeks ahead is enough · but in high season (November–April), especially New Year, Songkran and long weekends, the good rooms — particularly pool villas and beachfront resorts — sell out fast, so book 1–2 months ahead or more · in low season many places close, so check opening dates first.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest to book a Koh Lipe hotel?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion at different times — we recommend comparing all 3 before every booking. Each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save you hundreds to over a thousand baht per night on the higher-priced rooms.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Koh Lipe, and where does the boat leave from?
faq.a: Koh Lipe is in the Satun sea · the main way is a speedboat from Pak Bara pier in Satun, about 1.5 hours (there are also boats from Tammalang pier and from Langkawi, Malaysia) · boats land at Pattaya Beach, the main beach · the island has no roads for cars — get around on foot or by motorbike taxi; it's small enough to cross in 15–20 minutes.

faq.q: ❓ When is the best time to visit Koh Lipe?
faq.a: The best weather on Koh Lipe is roughly November–April, with clear seas, low surf and clear skies (this is high season, so prices are higher and it's busier) · May–October is low season, with rougher seas and rain, and many resorts close while some boats stop running · if you go then, always check that your hotel and the boats are operating before you book.
